# Getting Support

Thank you for using our projects! If you need help or have questions, please use the following channels instead of opening a GitHub issue:

## 💬 GitHub Discussions
For general questions, discussions, and sharing ideas, please visit the GitHub Discussions section of the respective repository.

## 🛠️ Issue Tracker
Only use the issue tracker to report bugs or request new features. For questions or support, use the Discussions instead.
